standard: World-level superiority across major finance domains, historically original and generalizable advances, rigorous reproducibility, external impact, and autonomous recursive growth.
maximum_claim: advanced broad finance research system with strong rigor, multiple finite engines, and one replicated domain-bounded empirical discovery

dimensions.boundary: No sealed cross-domain wins over current frontier systems in asset pricing, implementable portfolios, valuation, credit, banking, insurance, derivatives and risk.
FIN-RVI-002-C1 is a replicated domain-bounded empirical result, not a new general financial theory, theorem, instrument, mechanism or universally superior algorithm.
Coverage is broad, but most executable engines are finite or synthetic and lack real transfer across markets, institutions, countries and regimes.
Point-in-time contracts, hashes, fail-closed abstention, adversarial tests, public CI and independent replay are strong, but not universal across every engine.
One public-finance result changed attribution safety, but broad deployed impact on returns, capital, banking, insurance and policy is not established.
The Solver and tool system can diagnose and execute experiments, but cannot yet autonomously achieve and preserve SOTA across finance.

superseded_interpretations.775: knowledge-base maturity estimate, not absolute world SOTA
superseded_interpretations.820: internal FIN-RVI ten-gate score, not absolute world SOTA
superseded_interpretations.1000: completion of the bounded FIN-RVI contract, not all of finance
